== Description ==

Tournament hall at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025, with [[Brandon Baity]] (left edge, olive zip jacket) and [[Brian Fred]] (foreground right, black Colts sleeveless jersey) playing [[Benji Chu]] (standing, unlabeled background players).
